name: 27 - API - Generate Upcoming Appointment Confirmations - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        LEAST(GREATEST($2::INTEGER, 0), 720) AS window_start_hours,
        LEAST(GREATEST($3::INTEGER, 1), 720) AS window_end_hours,
        LEAST(GREATEST($4::INTEGER, 1), 168) AS response_deadline_hours,
        $5::TEXT AS channel,
        LEAST(GREATEST($6::INTEGER, 1), 500) AS result_limit
),

expired_requests AS (
    UPDATE appointment_confirmation_requests request

    SET
        status = 'expired',
        updated_at = NOW()

    WHERE request.status = 'pending'
      AND request.expires_at <= NOW()

    RETURNING request.id
),

expiry_barrier AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS expired_count
    FROM expired_requests
),

clinic_context AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS clinic_id,
        c.name AS clinic_name,
        c.timezone,

        r.window_start_hours,
        r.window_end_hours,
        r.response_deadline_hours,
        r.channel,
        r.result_limit

    FROM request_data r

    CROSS JOIN expiry_barrier barrier

    INNER JOIN clinics c
        ON c.name = r.clinic_name
       AND c.is_active = TRUE

    ORDER BY c.id
    LIMIT 1
),

eligible_appointments AS (
    SELECT
        a.id AS appointment_id,
        a.clinic_id,
        a.doctor_id,
        a.patient_id,
        a.service_id,
        a.starts_at,
        a.ends_at,
        a.status AS appointment_status,

        c.clinic_name,
        c.timezone,
        c.response_deadline_hours,
        c.channel,

        p.full_name AS patient_name,
        p.mobile,

        d.full_name AS doctor_name,
        s.name AS service_name

    FROM appointments a

    INNER JOIN clinic_context c
        ON c.clinic_id = a.clinic_id

    INNER JOIN patients p
        ON p.id = a.patient_id

    INNER JOIN doctors d
        ON d.id = a.doctor_id

    LEFT JOIN services s
        ON s.id = a.service_id

    WHERE a.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')

      AND a.starts_at >=
            NOW()
            + MAKE_INTERVAL(
                hours => c.window_start_hours
            )

      AND a.starts_at <
            NOW()
            + MAKE_INTERVAL(
                hours => c.window_end_hours
            )

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM appointment_confirmation_requests active_request

          WHERE active_request.appointment_id = a.id
            AND active_request.status = 'pending'
      )

    ORDER BY a.starts_at, a.id

    LIMIT (
        SELECT result_limit
        FROM clinic_context
    )
),

inserted_requests AS (
    INSERT INTO appointment_confirmation_requests (
        appointment_id,
        confirmation_token,
        status,
        channel,
        request_created_at,
        expires_at
    )

    SELECT
        eligible.appointment_id,

        MD5(
            RANDOM()::TEXT
            || CLOCK_TIMESTAMP()::TEXT
            || eligible.appointment_id::TEXT
        ),

        'pending',
        eligible.channel,
        NOW(),

        LEAST(
            eligible.starts_at,
            NOW()
            + MAKE_INTERVAL(
                hours => eligible.response_deadline_hours
            )
        )

    FROM eligible_appointments eligible

    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

    RETURNING
        id AS confirmation_request_id,
        appointment_id,
        confirmation_token,
        status AS confirmation_status,
        channel,
        request_created_at,
        expires_at
),

request_details AS (
    SELECT
        request.confirmation_request_id,
        request.confirmation_token,
        request.confirmation_status,
        request.channel,
        request.request_created_at,
        request.expires_at,

        eligible.appointment_id,
        eligible.patient_name,
        eligible.mobile,
        eligible.doctor_name,
        eligible.service_name,
        eligible.timezone,
        eligible.starts_at,
        eligible.ends_at,
        eligible.appointment_status

    FROM inserted_requests request

    INNER JOIN eligible_appointments eligible
        ON eligible.appointment_id =
           request.appointment_id
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN FALSE
        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN 'clinic_not_found'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM request_details
        )
            THEN 'no_confirmation_requests_needed'

        ELSE 'confirmation_requests_created'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN 'کلینیک مطابق ورودی پیدا نشد.'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM request_details
        )
            THEN 'در بازه زمانی انتخاب‌شده نوبتی برای ایجاد درخواست تأیید وجود ندارد.'

        ELSE 'درخواست‌های تأیید نوبت آماده ارسال شدند.'
    END AS message,

    r.clinic_name,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
        FROM request_details
    ) AS confirmation_request_count,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'confirmation_request_id',
                        confirmation_request_id,

                    'confirmation_token',
                        confirmation_token,

                    'appointment_id',
                        appointment_id,

                    'patient_name',
                        patient_name,

                    'mobile',
                        mobile,

                    'doctor_name',
                        doctor_name,

                    'service_name',
                        service_name,

                    'appointment_date',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            starts_at
                            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                            'YYYY-MM-DD'
                        ),

                    'start_time',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            starts_at
                            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                            'HH24:MI'
                        ),

                    'end_time',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            ends_at
                            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                            'HH24:MI'
                        ),

                    'appointment_status',
                        appointment_status,

                    'channel',
                        channel,

                    'expires_at',
                        expires_at,

                    'next_action',
                        'send_confirmation_request'
                )
                ORDER BY starts_at
            )
            FROM request_details
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS confirmation_requests

FROM request_data r;

parameters.content:
## تولید درخواست تأیید پیش از مراجعه

1. ابتدا Workflow شماره 26 را یک‌بار اجرا کن.

2. این Workflow نوبت‌های بازه آینده را پیدا کرده و برای هرکدام توکن تأیید می‌سازد.

3. در این مرحله پیام واقعاً ارسال نمی‌شود؛ خروجی برای اتصال به WhatsApp، SMS یا تماس آماده است.

4. اجرای دوباره، درخواست pending تکراری برای همان نوبت نمی‌سازد.
